scope_guards: Be First's statutory service role is not evidence of a specific application outcome.
Application-number or address search is discovery until the exact site and case are reconciled.
Consultation and public comments are not permission, refusal or final decision evidence.
The final decision must be read from the exact Public Access case record.
Late or absent comments do not determine an application's outcome.
Local Land Charges searches are extent- and date-specific and require clearly marked plans.
Local Land Charges, the planning register and HMLR title serve different legal/evidential functions.
No score or promotion is written without exact case outcome, title relation and executed overlays.
